label: lockpick
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() Scene = GK.Stage.Spawn{ template = "chest", distance = 2, items = { "potion" } } Osi.TemplateAddTo(GK.Stage.Templates.thieves_tools, H, 3, 0) return Scene

then.server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() Osi.Use(H, Scene[1], "") return true
local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() pcall(Osi.UseSpell, H, "Target_Knock", Scene[1]) return true

label: lock-with-key
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() Scene = GK.Stage.Spawn{ template = "chest", distance = 2 } Osi.Lock(Scene[1], "TourKey") return Scene

then.server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() Osi.Use(H, Scene[1], "") return true

label: trap-disarm
server: local rows = GK.Stage.Usables("DisarmTrap", { limit = 2 }) SceneTraps = rows if rows[1] then GK.Stage.UseItem(rows[1].uuid) end return rows

label: combine
server: local rows = GK.Stage.Usables("Combine", { limit = 3 }) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do Osi.ToInventory(r.uuid, Osi.GetHostCharacter(), 1, 1, 0) end SceneCombine = rows return rows

then.server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() if SceneCombine[1] then Osi.Use(H, SceneCombine[1].uuid, "") end return true
local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() if SceneCombine[1] and SceneCombine[2] then pcall(Osi.Combine, H, SceneCombine[1].uuid, SceneCombine[2].uuid, "", "", "", 0) end return true

label: insert-and-teleport-items
server: local out = {} for _, kind in ipairs({ "Insert", "Teleport", "Throw", "UseSpell", "PlaySound", "Unknown31", "SpawnCharacter", "ConstrainedAction" }) do local rows = GK.Stage.Usables(kind, { limit = 1 }) if rows[1] then GK.Stage.UseItem(rows[1].uuid) out[#out + 1] = kind end end return out

label: experience
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() local did = {} for _, name in ipairs({ "PartyAddActualExperience", "PartyAddExplorationExperience", "PartyAddExperience", "AddExperience", "SetLevel" }) do if Osi[name] then did[#did + 1] = name .. "=" .. tostring(pcall(Osi[name], H, 400)) end end return did

label: tadpole
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() local did = {} for _, call in ipairs({ { "SetTadpoleTreeState", H, 2 }, { "AddTadpole", H, 2 }, { "AddTadpolePower", H, "TAD_Charm", 1 }, { "SetTag", H, "c15c2234-9b19-453e-99cc-00b7358b9fce" } }) do if Osi[call[1]] then did[#did + 1] = call[1] .. "=" .. tostring(pcall(Osi[call[1]], table.unpack(call, 2))) end end return did

label: party-split
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() local n = 0 for _, c in ipairs({ "S_Player_ShadowHeart_3ed74f06-3c60-42dc-83f6-f034cb47c679", "S_Player_Gale_ad9af97d-75da-406a-ae13-7071c563f604" }) do pcall(Osi.SetOnStage, c, 1) pcall(Osi.TeleportTo, c, H, "", 0, 0, 0, 0, 1) pcall(Osi.PROC_GLO_PartyMembers_Add, c, H) end return GK.Stage.Party()

then.server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() for _, m in ipairs(GK.Stage.Party()) do if m:sub(-36) ~= H:sub(-36) then pcall(Osi.DetachFromPartyGroup, m) end end return true
local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() for _, m in ipairs(GK.Stage.Party()) do if m:sub(-36) ~= H:sub(-36) then pcall(Osi.AttachToPartyGroup, m, H) end end return true
local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() for _, m in ipairs(GK.Stage.Party()) do if m:sub(-36) ~= H:sub(-36) then pcall(Osi.PROC_GLO_PartyMembers_Remove, m, H, 1) end end return GK.Stage.Party()

label: misty-step
server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() GK.Stage.Teach("Target_MistyStep") Osi.RestoreParty(H) local p = GK.Stage.Position() Osi.UseSpellAtPosition(H, "Target_MistyStep", p[1] + 6, p[2], p[3], 1) return true

then.server: local H = Osi.GetHostCharacter() GK.Stage.Teach("Target_DimensionDoor") Osi.RestoreParty(H) local p = GK.Stage.Position() Osi.UseSpellAtPosition(H, "Target_DimensionDoor", p[1] + 9, p[2], p[3], 1) return true
